filesystem.description: Read/write files outside the project workspace (~). Useful for shared notes, dotfiles, cross-project resources.

fetch.description: HTTP fetcher with content extraction. Use for docs scraping, API discovery, content downloads.

sequential-thinking.description: Step-by-step structured reasoning. Useful for hard architecture/debug problems.

sqlite.description: Local SQLite for ad-hoc data exploration, prototyping, or persisting session notes. DB lives at .claude/state/local.db (gitignored).

puppeteer.description: Headless browser for E2E testing, screenshot capture, scraping JS-rendered pages.

memory.description: Knowledge-graph memory across sessions. Complements Claude Code's built-in memory with structured entities + relations.
